name: brightloop-subscriptions
description: Subscription Management System — plans, subscriptions, recurring billing, payments and revenue reporting in one place.

scripts.vercel-build: prisma generate && rm -f prisma/demo.db && export DATABASE_URL="file:$(pwd)/prisma/demo.db" && prisma db push --skip-generate && BRIGHTLOOP_SEEDING=1 tsx prisma/seed.ts && next build
scripts.perf: DATABASE_URL=file:./perf.db prisma db push --skip-generate && DATABASE_URL=file:./perf.db tsx prisma/seed.ts && DATABASE_URL=file:./perf.db tsx --conditions react-server scripts/perf.ts
scripts.test: rm -f prisma/test.db && DATABASE_URL=file:./test.db prisma db push --skip-generate >/dev/null && DATABASE_URL=file:./test.db tsx prisma/seed.ts >/dev/null && DATABASE_URL=file:./test.db tsx --conditions react-server --test tests/*.test.ts
